formula_or_assumption: min(MZFW−DOW, MTOW−DOW−departure_fuel_with_reserves, MLW−DOW−arrival_fuel) minus non-cargo traffic load
required_inputs: Aircraft-specific DOW; departure fuel including taxi/contingency/alternate/final reserve as dispatch requires; arrival fuel; aircraft-specific operating limits
source_or_basis: RRJ-95B published limits S03; DOW and fuel UNKNOWN
caution: Arrival-fuel term must match defined arrival mass basis; apply approved dispatch calculation, not only trip fuel.

formula_or_assumption: max(0, min(structural payload ceiling, aircraft hold mass/volume/geometry/floor limits) − passenger mass − checked baggage − cabin baggage included in mass basis − mail − company/operational load)
required_inputs: Consistent mass definitions, actual checked/cabin baggage, mail/COMAT, passenger count/mass basis, package dimensions and volume
source_or_basis: RW hold max S04 is limit only
caution: Avoid double count: standard passenger mass may already include cabin baggage per operator definition; checked bags separately if excluded. 20kg standard allowance and standard passenger weights are scenarios, not actual masses. Hold volume can bind before kg.

formula_or_assumption: max(actual gross kg, volumetric kg under contracted divisor and rounding rule) subject to AWB rules
required_inputs: Actual packed dimensions, divisor, rounding, minimum charge
source_or_basis: No public route-specific RW rule found
caution: Chargeable kg is billing basis, not physical payload kg.

formula_or_assumption: gross cargo receipts − handling − agent commission − incremental fuel − displaced passenger/baggage contribution
